offers.displayDescription: Hurl the axe forward, dealing up to 800 damage (further increased by determination) to enemies in its path and gaining 15 meter when hitting a Behemoth. Catch the axe to gain 30 meter.
Hold to load ammo into the hammer. Release to create an aether vent that buffs players who step over it, granting them up to +35% damage based on ammo quality.

Unleash energy forward in a pressure wave, dealing 500 damage to the closest target and 166 damage to up to 2 other nearby targets. Deals up to +100% damage when Tempest Form and Karma Breaker's effects are active.

Activate at full meter to enter Overdrive, gaining +20% attack speed and causing attacks to deal +60-80 aoe damage. Reactivate to parry and riposte a Behemoth attack, dealing 800 damage and granting 1 Valour when successful (2 second cooldown).
Press to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo and perform a flying lunge attack that deals up to 1200 damage based on distance and ammo quality.
Tonics consumed while your axe is thrown have +50% effectiveness.
Perfectly charged attacks grants +15 meter on hit, but no longer grant resolve
After using a special, your next special use within 4 seconds is free.
After using a special, deal +100% damage to objects created by Behemoths for 6 seconds.
Ammo decreased to 2, but bonus from aethercharged ammo is increased by 300%.
Priming attacks increases attack speed by 10% until the combo ends. Stacks.
Empowered Reloading at exactly 0 ammo decreases the cooldown of both abilities by 4 seconds.
While empowered, deal +50% damage to objects created by Behemoths
After the Bladesurge projectile travels a short distance, the damage is increased by 100%.
After using any Valour combo, your next Valour combo within 5 seconds deals +30% damage.
After a dodge piercing attack, gain +50% wound damage for 8 seconds.
Each time the Behemoth is wounded, gain +6% damage. Stacks up to 10.
Reduces max health. Dealing damage stacks increased damage dealt for a short period.
Prevents you from having over half health. Increases critical strike chance.
Reduces healing from Slayer Flask. Increases range of Pylons.
Reduces healing from Slayer Flask. Using your flask restores other Slayers' health.
Reduces max stamina. Increases movespeed and reduces sprint cost.
Reduces max health. Dodging through behemoth attacks grants health shields to all slayers.
